notes.title: Changelog for May 1st, 2021
notes.content:
Disaster Drive playtesters,

In v0.1.2 I've made a couple minor changes to the UI.

[olist]
[*] Fix cutoff text on main menu and loading screen for 16:10 resolutions
[*] Fix typo on pause menu's keyboard help prompt
[/olist]
